ruling: USER R-870: A DRAW RESAMPLES THE CANCELLABLE GENERATION. The unit is not open and is not re-argued here.
why_this_exists: CLAUDE.md rule 6. Every arm result this programme has produced is retracted. The next number published must have had its null declared IN ADVANCE, in the repo, with a commit ref. This file is that declaration; da_null_design.py evaluates every clause as a predicate so none of it is a sentence beside a table (rule 10).

permutation.resampled: WHICH cancellable generations the arm cancels
held_fixed: the reference path (the neutral no-cancel book)
the NUMBER of generations cancelled (the action count)
the side composition of the cancelled set
the hour composition of the cancelled set
permutation.why_not_rows: rows are not actions (1.99 rows/fill, max 23), so a row-matched control fails rule 7
permutation.why_not_cancels: cancels are outcome-selected (rule 1), and the ledger carries no CANCEL row kind at all

enforcement.action_count: EXACT. |drawn| == |arm cancels|; a draw that cannot reach the count is REFUSED, never truncated.
enforcement.side: EXACT per side. The drawn set's per-side counts equal the arm's per-side counts.
enforcement.hour: EXACT per UTC hour. Where an hour has fewer eligible generations than the arm cancelled in it, the draw REFUSES with MATCH_INFEASIBLE_HOUR and the hour's deficit is reported; it is never silently rebalanced.

matching.on_failure: REFUSE by name and report the deficit. A relaxed match is a different null and must be declared as one.

minimum_sample.source_of_the_bar: de_multiday_gate1_params_v29.json min_draws_per_arm_day, a PRE-DECLARED artifact -- never the receipt's own claim

estimand.definition: trades cash flow + residual x settlement, in cents
estimand.trades_leg: sum over fills of -(signed share delta) x px_cents
estimand.residual_leg: net_shares per slug x settle_cents, settle = 100 if up_won else 0
estimand.the_5s_markout_is: A DIAGNOSTIC. It may be reported beside the result and may NEVER be the tested quantity.

latency.rule: rule 7 -- latency enters the estimand: value only tranches after t + L
latency.L_place_ms_source: the book's own builder receipt, never typed here

exclusions_are_statuses.note: every exclusion travels with its COUNT (rule 4). A zero with no sibling status is NOT COMPUTABLE, not 'none excluded'.

consumed_days.why: all four September days have been SEEN -- books built, point estimates read, thresholds and repairs driven against them (rule 11). They cannot validate anything chosen on them.
consumed_days.validation_requires: later untouched days, at least 5 complete UTC days, none of them 09-03..09-06

falsifiers.positive_control_the_null_MUST_flag: an ORACLE arm that cancels exactly the generations with the worst realised settled value must land in the extreme right tail; a null that does not flag it has no power and its zeros mean nothing
falsifiers.known_bad_the_null_MUST_refuse: a draw set whose action count, side composition or hour composition does not match the arm's -- and a run whose matched_on is absent, None, or names a unit its inputs do not implement

wall_clock.status: NOT ESTABLISHED -- see da_null_design.py; this is a BLOCKER on authorising the race, not a footnote

wall_clock.DA_own_observation_disagrees: one draw ran >=225 s without completing (DA 172), about 24x the ~9.5 s/draw the read estimate implies. The estimate and the observation are not reconciled.
